verdict.rationale: First-party support docs say Copilot connectors link to OneDrive, Outlook.com (email, calendar, contacts), Google Drive, and Gmail/Google Calendar. They give concrete search examples for files, emails, and calendar events, and state the connectors are available on Copilot.com and Copilot Mobile. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the consumer connectors (the only positive community comment concerns Office 365 Copilot), and documented connector availability beyond web and mobile.
